integrity: Numerical orientations are not used as infinite proofs; the exact rational endpoint certificates are embedded. No empirical validation, attribution of field effect or historical-priority guarantee is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-time terminal settlement; symmetric uniform nearest-neighbor lateral mixing, reflecting banks, no earlier capture or mortality; five-lane suitability example is deliberately idealized, not calibrated to a field site. State-minimality holds only for this fixed linear terminal observable on an equal-rate path.
title: Five lateral lanes are sharp for two optimal mixing intensities in a nursery-connectivity model
